title: Full body · 19 September
label: 40-MINUTE FULL-BODY · SUPERSETS
coachNote: 40 minutes in the gym. SUPERSET FORMAT: A1 Goblet squat → A2 DB bench, then rest 75–90 sec; repeat 3 rounds. B1 Lat pulldown → B2 DB Romanian deadlift, then rest 75–90 sec; repeat 3 rounds. C1 Standing calf raise → C2 Hanging knee/leg raise, then rest ~60 sec; repeat 3 rounds. Move directly between the two exercises in each pair with only transition time. Finish with 4 × 20 m sled pushes, resting 60–75 sec. Working sets around RPE 7–8 / 2–3 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: A1 · SUPERSET A — Goblet squat
exercises.note: Pair with A2 DB bench. Do A1 → A2, then rest 75–90 sec. Start at 20 kg and move toward 24 kg only if the first set is crisp and comfortable.

exercises.name: A2 · SUPERSET A — Dumbbell bench press
exercises.note: Immediately after A1 goblet squat. After this exercise rest 75–90 sec, then repeat A1/A2. Weight is per dumbbell. If 26 kg × 10 is clean with 2–3 reps in reserve, record it and we can progress next time.

exercises.name: B1 · SUPERSET B — Lat pulldown
exercises.note: Pair with B2 DB Romanian deadlift. Do B1 → B2, then rest 75–90 sec. Use clean controlled reps; don't chase the heavier setting if form changes.

exercises.name: B2 · SUPERSET B — Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Immediately after B1 lat pulldown. After this exercise rest 75–90 sec, then repeat B1/B2. Choose a comfortable pair after a light practice set. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: C1 · SUPERSET C — Standing calf raises
exercises.note: Pair with C2 hanging knee/leg raise. Do C1 → C2, then rest ~60 sec. Controlled full range: pause at the top and lower slowly. Prefer single-leg if you can maintain clean form.

exercises.name: C2 · SUPERSET C — Hanging knee / leg raises
exercises.note: Immediately after C1 calf raises. After this exercise rest ~60 sec, then repeat C1/C2. Use the hardest controlled version you can perform without swinging; progressively straighten the legs.

exercises.name: FINISHER — Sled push
exercises.note: 4 × 20 m. Rest 60–75 sec between runs. One set is 10 m out + 10 m back. Keep these strong but controlled; record the actual added load.
